The critics of Nicolaus Copernicus included Catholic clerics, conservative astronomers, and later church censors.
They rejected the moving Earth as a threat to Scripture and tradition.
Their opposition grew stronger after his book spread.
Which groups opposed his heliocentric theory?
Who defended the geocentric view?
Why did they object?
How radical his proposal appeared!
What a danger it seemed to old teaching!
Indeed, the critics were numerous!
